set.body: Rebase VolumeAtlas and SurfaceAtlas on typed parcellations; separate parcel metadata, display order, network surjections, atlas identity, and provenance; rename atlas metadata currently called Region. Replace per-parcel rescans with one-pass aggregation, require explicit overlap alignment, and retain optimized weighted contact scans with relation differential tests. Acceptance follows phase 7 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md and all atlas JVM and Scala.js parity gates.
set.title: Locus 7: rebase atlas on typed parcellations
